actions.reason: Shop log says PAYMENTS_TOKEN not set; .env defines misspelled PAYMENT_TOKEN, so checkout sends no token and gets 401.

root_causes.evidence: .env defined PAYMENT_TOKEN (typo) while app.py reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN; shop log warned token not set; payments returned 401 on /charge.

report.summary: Checkout returned 502 because the .env key was misspelled (PAYMENT_TOKEN instead of PAYMENTS_TOKEN), so the shop sent no token and the payments connector rejected charges with 401. I renamed the key and kept the existing value. I then restarted the shop, and all 5 smoke tests pass, including a checkout that was persisted.
